title: The China brain could not even simulate one person's input and output

statements.text: Block's Chinese nation is not organized remotely like a human brain, and it could not simulate a person's input-output relations at all: there are not nearly enough Chinese, nor would a sphere out to the orbit of Pluto packed with people be enough. So the case gives no counterexample to a functionalism that demands an organization like ours.

sources.quote: There are not nearly enough Chinese - not remotely enough.
